text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What did you say?! "Pop-Out Spring 
Eyeball Glasses" have been discontinued?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Kh, without that... I can't put on my 
'cute girl getting weirdly overexcited 
because she's so happy during the concert' 
act...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not too late! If we check every 
novelty and gag gift shop across town!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Despite running around trying to find it, 
the item Royce and Royce sought was 
nowhere to be found, seemingly forcing a 
partial change in the produce plan."
